Payments & software engineering · Atlanta

Hi, I'm Thomas. I build the software that moves money.

For eight years I've worked across card payments end to end: mobile SDKs, EMV terminal fleets, gateways and in-store platforms. I lead engineering teams, set the standards they ship by, and I'm exploring how AI coding agents can work safely in codebases where every mistake has a dollar amount.

Payments MCP server

Gives coding agents real payments tools, so they can read terminal logs and authorization messages alongside you instead of guessing.

  • Decodes EMV TLV and ISO 8583 as agent tools
  • Masks card numbers before anything reaches the model
  • Works with any MCP-capable coding agent

PlannedPayments

EMV TLV decoder

Paste the hex from a terminal log and get every EMV tag named and explained, including what each flag in the TVR means.

  • Runs entirely in the browser; logs never leave your machine
  • Explains TVR and TSI bit flags in plain language
  • Shareable links for debugging with your team

Pew-Pew-Pew.io

A multiplayer browser game built to see how far Socket.io could go for real-time state sync between a server and many clients.

  • Entity-component system for game logic
  • Spatial hashing keeps collision checks cheap as players join
  • Express and Socket.io server streaming state to every client
